phase: D14 Phase 0 (exploratory, development split, no seal spent)
intent: Determine what sequence property carries D12's confirmed TSS polarity (E2 = downstream tiles {25,27} minus upstream tiles {21,22,23}, mask target-specific loss), and whether it is an artifact of the [MASK] token.

architectural_deductions_no_compute.position_embeddings: none; bert_layers.py comment '# no position embeddings! ALiBi'
architectural_deductions_no_compute.alibi_form: -m_h * |i - j|  (bert_layers.py:394 uses torch.abs) -> SYMMETRIC, no signed positional term
architectural_deductions_no_compute.consequence: The model cannot encode 'downstream of TSS' as a positional fact. The only positional asymmetry available is distance-to-[CLS], which uniformly favours UPSTREAM in every head at every layer.
architectural_deductions_no_compute.prediction_for_track_B: Only the shallow-slope band (H5,H6,H7; headwind <= 0.13 logits) can support downstream dominance via direct [CLS] attention without a large content term. Everything else needs relay.

d9_reaudit.finding: Tile 26 is NOT in D12's E2 contrast. D12's own E4 (which includes tile 26) also failed. D9's null is consistent with D12 and says nothing about tiles 25/27, which had never been reorder-tested.
d9_reaudit.record_correction_needed: CLAIMS.md H8 cites D9 as 'exact-composition native reordering already failed development' in support of a general conclusion. That null is bounded to tile 26.

enumeration_scaling.note: dinucleotide_preserving_reorders enumerates ALL Euler trails - exponential
enumeration_scaling.consequence: 30-nt windows are unreachable by enumeration. Resolved by reordering PER 10-nt TILE, which also matches D12's endpoint structure exactly.

three_arm_paired_decomposition.split: D8 development (already open) - EXPLORATORY, needs sealed confirmation

mask.what_it_does: removes content AND inserts [MASK] (off-manifold for a fine-tuned classifier)

gc_depletion.what_it_does: G->A / C->T, dose 3 of 10 nt - real bases, changes GC and destroys CpG

dinucleotide_reorder.what_it_does: destroys arrangement, holds mono- AND linear-dinucleotide counts EXACTLY fixed (so CpG count is exactly preserved) - real bases

reading: Arrangement, holding dinucleotide composition exactly fixed, does NOT carry the polarity (~3%, CI spans 0).
Composition change with REAL bases DOES reproduce the polarity (paired vs reorder excludes 0).
mask - gc_depletion spans zero, so the [MASK] off-manifold artifact is NOT required to explain the effect.
Therefore D12's TSS polarity is composition-borne (GC/CpG), not motif-syntactic.
scope_limits: 'Arrangement' means arrangement MODULO exact dinucleotide content; a dinucleotide-preserving shuffle retains CpG count and much local structure.
gc_depletion is directional (only reduces GC) at a fixed dose of 3; it shows GC matters asymmetrically but does not isolate GC from other correlates of G/C bases.
The 90-locus three-way intersection is a supply-selected subset; its mask-E2 (+0.575) is higher than the full development mask-E2 (+0.405).

exploratory_motif_stratification.note: Selected AFTER seeing D12's result, on open data. Prediction-fixing only, not evidence.
exploratory_motif_stratification.geometry: Inr at +1 falls in tile 25 (downstream arm); TATA at -27 falls in tile 22 (upstream arm).
exploratory_motif_stratification.prediction_outcome: BOTH directional predictions FAILED. Predicted TATA+ -> smaller polarity (core function moves upstream); observed LARGER (+0.76). Predicted Inr+ -> larger polarity; observed slightly smaller. n=18 for TATA+ is small and this coheres with a composition-class explanation (TATA+ promoters are AT-rich/CpG-poor), not a motif-mechanism one.

variance_for_power.loci_yield: 192 development loci -> 113 with reorder-E2, 120 with gc_depletion-E2, 90 with all three
